title: Firefox’s Smart Window adds AI form filling and webpage monitoring
hook_text: Firefox brings AI to your browser
hook_before: Firefox just integrated AI directly into your browser windows.
script:
Firefox Smart Window is faster than manual typing.
The updated Smart Window tool now auto-fills complex online forms.
It pulls your work history from open tabs like LinkedIn profiles.
Mozilla designed this to speed up repetitive job application tasks.
This AI context-awareness is a major shift from basic autofill.
The feature will monitor your active session to gather data.
Would you trust your browser to manage your personal job data?

editor.one_line: Weak hook and repetitive, low-effort visuals fail to meet premium news standards.
script_fixes: LINE 1: Replace with a punchier hook like 'Firefox is turning your browser into a personal assistant.'
LINE 5: Remove this line; it is vague commentary that adds no new information.
LINE 6: Be more specific about the privacy implications or the 'Smart Window' mechanism.
visual_notes: line 1: The same Firefox logo is held for too long across multiple frames.
line 4: Using The Verge logo as a visual for a Mozilla feature is confusing and misleading.
line 6: The Firefox logo is repeated again, creating visual fatigue.
